Another finding across multiple polls was a slight edge by Democrats on the generic ballot in the upcoming midterm elections.

In Marquette's August poll, 46% of registered voters preferred Democrats on the generic ballot, compared with 44% for Republicans. Among likely voters, though, the Democrats' lead over Republicans increased, with 51% of likely voters saying they would vote for the Democratic candidate in their districts, and only 45% preferring the Republican candidate. [...] Economist/YouGov and Emerson each had the Democratic lead on generic ballots sitting at around 8 percentage points, but for Emerson's poll, that was down from an 11.4 percentage point lead the previous month.
